dag.description: Multi-task LightGBM (MTGBM) end-to-end pipeline with three independent data branches: training, calibration (feeding percentile calibration), and a hold-out testing branch for out-of-sample evaluation. The calibrated model is packaged, payloaded, and registered for deployment.

agent_context.when_to_use: Train a multi-task LightGBM (MTGBM) model that learns several correlated transportation-risk targets jointly, then normalize raw scores with percentile calibration and independently validate on a hold-out testing dataset before deployment. Best when you need a distinct out-of-sample test branch separate from the calibration data.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you train a single target (use lightgbm/xgboost complete_e2e). If you do not need an independent hold-out test branch (use lightgbmmt_complete_e2e). If the testing branch must emit model-metrics and a wiki page (use the lightgbm percentile+testing variant with ModelMetricsComputation + ModelWikiGenerator). If raw model scores are fine and no percentile normalization is required (use lightgbmmt_complete_e2e with ModelCalibration).
differentiators: Multi-task LightGBM (MTGBM): LightGBMMTTraining + LightGBMMTModelEval learn correlated targets jointly
Adds an independent hold-out testing branch (CradleDataLoading_testing -> TabularPreprocessing_testing -> LightGBMMTModelEval_testing) on top of the calibration-eval branch
Uses PercentileModelCalibration (score-rank normalization) instead of the ModelCalibration used by lightgbmmt_complete_e2e
Testing branch is a metrics-only leaf: it neither feeds calibration nor deployment, and has no ModelMetricsComputation/ModelWikiGenerator

prerequisites.check: Multiple correlated labels available for joint training
prerequisites.how: Cradle SQL (training) returns more than one target column for MTGBM
Cradle SQL (testing) covers a period/split disjoint from both training and calibration
Cradle SQL (calibration) returns labels and features matching the training schema

common_pitfalls: All three branches (training/calibration/testing) must share an identical TabularPreprocessing feature schema
Package consumes LightGBMMTTraining + PercentileModelCalibration outputs, not the testing eval output
The testing branch is evaluation-only and does not gate registration; scores are calibrated from the calibration branch
